name: Zed
note: Zed's live thread list is sidebar_threads in db/0-stable/db.sqlite. The obvious-looking threads/threads.db is legacy — it stopped being written and left this row reporting a conversation days stale. Only Zed's own agent is read here: threads Zed hosts over ACP belong to that agent's harness and appear there with Zed as their host, so listing them again would double-count one conversation. Model, tokens and cost are unavailable either way — the conversation body is a zstd blob, and updated_at moves when a thread is opened, not per turn.

source.query: SELECT folder_paths, coalesce(nullif(title_override,''), nullif(title,''), 'thread'), created_at, max(updated_at, coalesce(interacted_at, updated_at)) FROM sidebar_threads WHERE coalesce(agent_id, '') = '' AND coalesce(archived, 0) = 0 AND coalesce(folder_paths, '') <> '' ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 20
